prompt:
USE: A flat game decal for a street name plate fixed to a stone wall in an old town. Straight-on orthographic view, no perspective. The plate fills the frame: it reaches the left and right edges, and it is so tall that only a thin clear strip, one twentieth of the frame height, stays above it and below it.
SUBJECT: A long rectangular vitreous-enamel street name plate with slightly rounded corners, ten units wide and three units tall. Deep dark blue enamel with a thin white border line set a little inside the edge. One line of white capital letters in a plain serif typeface, centred and evenly spaced: "ESCAPEMENT LANE". The letters are about two fifths of the plate height. A small round screw head sits at the middle of each short end. The enamel is old: slightly dulled, with a few small chips at the edge and at the screws that show dark steel and a trace of rust.
TEXT RULES: Draw exactly this one line, once, and no other text. Spelling: E-S-C-A-P-E-M-E-N-T, a space, L-A-N-E.
STYLE: Photographic realism with restraint. Satin enamel as seen under neutral light. Soft, even, shadowless light from all sides. No mirror reflections, no glow, so the colours read as base colour.
CONSTRAINTS: Fully transparent background outside the plate, with a crisp edge and no halo. Do not draw a checkerboard, a backdrop, a wall or a drop shadow. No logos, no watermarks. Original design only.
